The '''Ojoster sector''',<ref name="CGSWG">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> also known as the '''Ojostor sector''', was a [[sector]] located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[space station]] [[Otor's Hub]].<ref name="Inferno Squad" />
